title: Grilled Sirloin with Peruvian Gochujang Glaze
description: A fusion of Japanese and Peruvian flavors, this grilled sirloin recipe is a delicious and spicy twist on a classic dish.

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.notes: adds sweetness to balance out the heat

instructions: Season the sirloin with salt and pepper.
Grill the sirloin for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130°F for medium-rare.
While the sirloin is cooking, mix the gochujang sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and grated ginger in a small bowl.
Brush the glaze onto the sirloin during the last minute of grilling.
Remove the sirloin from the grill and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the sirloin against the grain and garnish with chopped green onions.
